latency.warmup_path: full pipeline with CLAHE+Gamma on the first sorted test frame
latency.selection: first 200 test paths after alphabetical sort
notes: resize_ms includes face detection because that is where the system resizes the crop to 224.
normalize_ms is BGR to RGB float32 in the 0-255 range. MobileNet preprocessing stays inside the model.
CLAHE+Gamma is the enhancement that exists in the project. There is no separate denoising filter.
Low-light simulation is not part of latency; it belongs to dataset construction.

softmax_sanity.note: Closed-set argmax accuracy of the softmax head. This is not the cosine protocol.
